'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Ukraine]] launches [[missile]] and [[Drone warfare|drone strikes]] across [[Krasnodar Krai]], [[Russia]], injuring two people and damaging several [[Oil refinery|oil refineries]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-missiles-hit-oil-terminal-port-kavkaz-russias-krasnodar-region-military-2024-05-31/ (Reuters)]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***At least three people are killed and 16 others are injured when Russian missiles hit civilian infrastructure in [[Kharkiv]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-shelling-hits-apartment-block-ukraines-kharkiv-officials-say-2024-05-30/ (Reuters)]
**[[Treatment of prisoners of war in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Ukraine and Russia announce their first exchange of prisoners of war in nearly four months, with 150 people freed following negotiations mediated by the [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-russia-announce-major-prisoner-swap-2024-05-31/ (Reuters)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[30 May 2024 Yemen strikes]]
***The death toll from yesterday's [[United States Navy|U.S. Navy]] and [[Royal Navy|British Navy]] [[airstrike]]s in [[Yemen]] increases to 16 with 35 others injured. [https://apnews.com/article/yemen-war-us-british-airstrikes-israel-hamas-12f99b7afc389a703f8dd333f2376b20 (AP)]
***The [[Houthi]] [[Supreme Political Council]] states that it launched an attack on the [[USS Dwight D. Eisenhower|USS ''Dwight D. Eisenhower'']], although [[U.S.|American]] officials deny this claim. *[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***Seven soldiers are killed and 28 others are injured in an offensive by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] near [[Khartoum]], [[Sudan]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article286414/ (Sudan Tribune)]
*[[2024 Mannheim stabbing]]
**A man with a knife stabs several people at an anti-Muslim rally in [[Mannheim]], [[Baden-Württemberg]], [[Germany]] including two [[Law enforcement in Germany|policemen]], including one in the neck, before being injured by a bullet. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/german-police-shoot-injure-man-who-attacked-far-right-demo-2024-05-31/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
